name: Uragiri
source:
Main character enjoys face expression of deceived girls. He believes that people want to be betrayed by others. His past memories are deleted by "organization", and now he gets into trust of girls and then kidnaps and trains them without any moral hesitation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公享受着被欺骗女孩们的表情。他相信人们渴望被他人背叛。他的过去记忆被“组织”抹去了，如今他取得女孩们的信任，然后毫无道德顾虑地绑架和调教她们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
